svg.title: Meta creative dashboard: how the tables join
svg.desc: Hand-drawn diagram. ad_insights_daily joins to ads on ad_id = id; ads joins to ad_creatives on creative.id = id; ad_creatives joins to page_posts on effective_object_story_id = post id. The creative url_tags put utm_content={{ad.id}} on every click, so GA4 sessions and orders join back to ad_insights_daily on ad_id.
svg.text: Meta creative dashboard: how the tables join
Keys in red. Meta names checked against developers.facebook.com (Graph API v26.0) on Oct 15, 2026.
4 url_tags puts the ad ID in utm_content on every click
5 ga4_sessions / orders .utm_content = ad_id (aggregate each side before joining)
Grain: one row per ad per day. Several ads can share one post, so roll up by post ID too. A spec sketch, not a full schema.
